name: Spunto Pack
description: Everything a remote development environment needs on top of a base image and common-utils: an in-browser VS Code (code-server), persistent terminal backends (tmux and/or dtach), and an optional SSH server. One feature, one pass, readable build log.

installCodeServer.description: Install code-server (VS Code in the browser).

codeServerVersion.description: code-server version to install, e.g. 4.101.2. 'latest' resolves at build time.

terminalBackend.description: Which persistent-terminal backend(s) to install. 'dtach' also pulls util-linux for script(1), used to replay a session's tail on attach.

configureTmux.description: Write a system-wide /etc/tmux.conf (mouse, OSC 52 clipboard, 50k scrollback, warm status bar). Read before the user's own ~/.tmux.conf, so it stays overridable.

installSshd.description: Install an OpenSSH server. Only the package: no sshd_config rewriting, no host key, no entrypoint — the surrounding platform is expected to own that policy. For a batteries-included SSH server, use ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/sshd instead.

strict.description: Fail the build when a requested component cannot be installed. Off by default: components are best-effort and the build ends with a warning summary instead.
